enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Wash face. Turn off shower. Dry body with towel. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Return to bedroom. Close door. Stand on mat. Stretch arms overhead. Bend forward. Stretch legs. Twist torso. Sit on bed. Pick up clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Stand up. Adjust clothes. Look in mirror. Comb hair.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Cook eggs and toast. Pour milk. Set table. Sit down with Member 2. Eat breakfast. Converse with Member 2. Finish eating. Clear dishes. Wash dishes. Put away dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the bedroom and organizing work materials
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up clothes from floor. Fold clothes. Put clothes in closet. Make bed. Smooth sheets. Fluff pillows. Arrange pillows. Pick up work papers from desk. Sort papers. Place in folders. Open desk drawer. Put folders in drawer. Close drawer. Pick up laptop. Place on desk. Plug in charger. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Adjust desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone messages and news about the transport strike, planning the remote workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Open news app. Read news about transport strike. Open calendar app. Review schedule. Open notes app. Type plan for remote workday. Close apps. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on community program coordination tasks on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Log in. Open email. Read and reply to emails. Open document. Edit document. Save. Open spreadsheet. Update spreadsheet. Make phone calls. Take notes. Open video conference. Participate. Close. Continue working. Take a break. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Prepare lunch. Cook lunch. Set table. Sit down with Member 2. Eat lunch. Converse with Member 2. Finish eating. Clear dishes. Wash dishes. Put away dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the sofa with Member 2 after lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Lean back. Pick up phone. Scroll through social media. Show phone to Member 2. Talk with Member 2. Put down phone. Adjust position. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on community program coordination tasks on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Continue working on tasks. Check emails. Make calls. Write reports. Update database. Take breaks. Stand up. Walk around. Sit back down. Resume work. Open document. Edit. Save. Open spreadsheet. Update. Make phone calls. Take notes. Open video conference. Participate. Close. Continue working. Take a break. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Making tea and having an afternoon snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on stove. Turn on stove. Wait for water to boil. Kettle whistles. Turn off stove. Pour hot water into teapot. Add tea leaves. Wait for tea to steep. Pour tea into cups. Pick up snacks. Place on plate. Carry to table. Sit down. Drink tea. Eat snack. Talk with Member 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal time, reading or light chores
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Close book. Put down book. Stand up. Pick up laundry. Fold laundry. Put away laundry. Sit back down.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash and chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add spices. Cook. Turn off stove. Serve food. Carry to table. Sit down with Member 2. Eat dinner. Converse. Clear dishes. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with Member 2 while they play video games
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Check messages. Watch Member 2 play video games. Comment on game. Pick up book. Read. Put down book. Watch TV. Talk with Member 2. Adjust sitting position.

Stand up. Walk to closet. Open closet. Take out vacuum cleaner. Unwind cord. Plug in cord. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum across floor. Move around furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug cord. Wind cord. Put vacuum back in closet. Close closet door.
Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Settle on program. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Lean back. Put down remote. Continue watching. Pick up remote. Change channel.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Rinse toothbrush. Put away toothbrush. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Get into bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media. Scroll. Watch videos. Read articles. Check messages. Reply to messages. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Sleeping.
